description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayMappingCommandHandler class in the Eclipse Hono client implementation, verifying its behavior under various scenarios such as handling registration data, gateway mappings, and command reply-to logic.

classes.name: GatewayMappingCommandHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of GatewayMappingCommandHandler, including registration assertions and gateway mapping logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the test fixture with mocks and initial state before each test.

methods.name: testHandleUsingEmptyDeviceData
methods.description: Verifies handle() behavior when device registration data does not contain 'via' mapping.

methods.name: testHandleReturningLastUsedGateway
methods.description: Tests handle() when registration has 'via' entries and last known gateway info is available.

methods.name: testHandleReturningLastUsedGatewayWithCommandReplyToSet
methods.description: Verifies that reply-to field is preserved when last gateway info is available.

methods.name: testHandleReturningSingleViaGateway
methods.description: Checks behavior when 'via' contains a single gateway and no last known gateway is found.

methods.name: testHandleWithNoMappedGatewayFound
methods.description: Verifies that the command is released if no gateway mapping can be determined.

methods.name: testHandleWithRegistrationClientException
methods.description: Ensures proper handling when the registration client throws an exception.
